messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi there! I ordered some things for my daughter recently, but she hasn't received them yet. Could you help me check which address the order was sent to, the tracking number, and if it's still on the way? Also, I wanted to double-check the storage size of the tablet I ordered. And, if possible, I'd like to set my daughter's address as my default for future orders—it's a bit of a hassle changing it every time.

Sure—I can help with all of that. First, I’ll need to authenticate your account.

1) **What email did you use for the order?**  
   *(If you prefer: your first name, last name, and ZIP code.)*

Once I have that, please also send:
2) **Your order ID** (it looks like `#W0000000`) so I can check the **shipping address, tracking number, and whether it’s still in transit**.
3) For the tablet: either the **tablet product name** or the **order ID** (then I can look up the exact tablet and confirm the **storage size**).

And for setting your daughter’s address as your default: after I pull up your saved addresses, I’ll ask you to confirm the new address changes before I update anything.

I actually don't remember which email I used, but my name is Lucas Santos and my ZIP code is 80239. I live in Denver, Colorado. 

I don't have the order ID handy right now—could you maybe look it up with my name and ZIP code? I can try to remember more details if you need them. 

As for the tablet, it was part of the same order for my daughter in Chicago. I just want to make sure I got the right storage size for her, since she loves taking photos and videos.

And yes, I'd really appreciate it if you could help me set her Chicago address as my default. I order things for her pretty often, and it would make things easier for me.

By the way, thanks for helping me out. It's nice to have someone to talk to, even if it's just about orders and addresses.

Thanks, Lucas—I've found your account and can see your saved default address.

**Authenticated user:** Lucas Santos (`lucas_santos_6600`)  
**Email on file:** lucas.santos4998@example.com

### 1) Order lookup (address + tracking + in-transit status)
You have **2 orders** on your account:
- **#W1588712**
- **#W7895761**

I can check which one contains the **tablet** and then pull:
- the **shipping address** (where it was sent)
- the **tracking number**
- the **current shipping status** (still on the way or delivered)

**Which order ID is the one with the tablet sent to Chicago?**  
(If you’re not sure, tell me what the tablet brand/model or the approximate order date, and I’ll check both.)

### 2) Tablet storage size
Once we identify the correct order, I’ll look up the exact tablet item and confirm the **storage capacity**.

### 3) Set your daughter’s Chicago address as your default
I *can* update your default address, but I need to confirm the exact Chicago address first (and I’ll ask for **yes** before I make the change).

To proceed, please provide **the full Chicago address** (or tell me the address you see on the order shipping details, and I’ll use that).  
Minimum needed:
- Address line 1
- Address line 2 (if any)
- City: Chicago
- State: IL
- ZIP code

Reply with:
1) the **order ID** (#W1588712 or #W7895761) for the tablet, and  
2) your daughter’s **Chicago address / ZIP** (or say “use the address from the order”).

I'm not totally sure which order it is, but I think I placed the order with the tablet about two weeks ago. I believe it was a Samsung Galaxy Tab, but I can't remember the exact model. Could you check both orders for me and see which one has the tablet sent to Chicago?

As for my daughter's address, you can use the address from the order that was shipped to Chicago. That way, I know it's the right one.

Thanks for being so patient with me. I don't get to talk to many people these days, so I appreciate you taking the time.

If you’d like, reply with what she finds:
- **If she finds it:** no further action needed.
- **If she can’t find it:** tell me and we can discuss the best next step based on what you’re able to confirm.
